CHUNG_FUCHS_1951.title: On the distribution of values of sums of random variables
CHUNG_FUCHS_1951.publication: Memoirs of the American Mathematical Society 6, pp. 1-12
CHUNG_FUCHS_1951.applies_to: families.py F10 uniform-step random walk; F15b bases and positive F15 scalings descended from F10
CHUNG_FUCHS_1951.theorem: For a one-dimensional random walk with iid increments of finite absolute first moment and mean zero, recurrent values exist. For a nondegenerate nonlattice increment distribution the recurrent-value set is all of R: every neighborhood of each fixed real value is visited infinitely often almost surely.

CHUNG_FUCHS_1951.application: OUR derivation: F10's increments are Uniform[-step,step], step>0, hence iid, nondegenerate, nonlattice, integrable and centered. Recurrence near every integer on a countable probability-one intersection excludes convergence, either signed infinite limit, and boundedness. Translation by x0 and multiplication by a fixed positive scale preserve these properties.
